kind.title: What is this Instagram account for?
kind.hint: So your tone and content ideas feel right.

name.title: What is your brand name and business category?
name.hint: The name that appears in your content, and what you do in a few words.

description.title: Tell us a little about your business.
description.hint: What you sell or offer, and what makes you different. 2–3 sentences is plenty.

audience.title: Who do you want to reach?
audience.hint: For example: moms aged 25–35 around Jakarta who enjoy easy home cooking.

posts.title: How often do you want to post each week?
posts.hint: This sets your content schedule and calendar. You can change it anytime on the Brand page.

style.title: What design style do you want?
style.hint: This is just a starting point for fonts and layouts. If you add design references or connect Instagram, those references will take priority.

fonts.title: Choose your design fonts.
fonts.hint: We’ve suggested fonts to match your style. Change them if your brand has its own.

referral.title: How did you hear about Carousely?
referral.hint: One last question, so we know how to reach more people like you.

done.title: All set! Here’s your brand style.
done.hint: You can change everything anytime on the Brand page.

wizard.failed: Could not reach the server. Try again.
wizard.name: Brand name
wizard.categoryPlaceholder: e.g. Coffee shop, local skincare, English courses
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. A palm sugar latte shop in Bandung. Beans from Garut farmers, student-friendly prices, open late.
wizard.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. Students and young professionals aged 18–30 in Bandung.
wizard.posts: {count, plural, one {# post / week} other {# posts / week}}
wizard.summary: Next, connect Instagram. We’ll use your logo and a few posts as layout examples. The <style>{name}</style> style still sets the fonts and overall feel, while your posts guide the layout.

page.title: Let’s get to know you
page.saveFailed: Could not save your answers. Try again.
page.databaseError: The database is unavailable. Check the Supabase configuration in .env.local.
page.logoInvalid: The logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
page.logoTooLarge: The logo is too large. The limit is 2 MB.

errors.posts: Choose one of the available weekly posting frequencies.
errors.referral: Your “how did you hear about us” answer must be at most {count} characters.
errors.website: That website address is not valid.

instagram.title: Let Carousely get to know your brand
instagram.hint: Type your brand's Instagram username. Mimo reads its profile, and you get {contents} free posts and {chats} Mimo chat messages at once.
instagram.label: Instagram username
instagram.privacy: We only read the public profile and posts. No Instagram password needed.
instagram.loginFailed: The Instagram login didn't work. You can continue with your username and connect it later in Settings.
instagram.calloutTitle: Have a Business or Creator account? Log in with Instagram for a bonus:
instagram.bonusContent: Free post number {count} opens at once
instagram.bonusPublish: Schedule and publish posts straight to Instagram
instagram.bonusBrand: A fuller brand kit: logo, colours and sample posts are taken automatically
instagram.check: How to check: open your Instagram profile. If it has a Professional dashboard button, your account is Business or Creator. A personal account can start with the username and log in later.

confirm.title: Is this your account?
confirm.hint: Check first, so Mimo learns from the right account.
confirm.privateNote: This account is private, so Mimo learns from its name, bio and your answers only.

not_found.title: Username not found
not_found.hint: Check the spelling, or continue without Instagram.

invalid.title: That is not an Instagram username
invalid.hint: A username has only letters, numbers, dots and underscores. Example: kopisinar.id

limited.title: Today's lookups are used up
limited.hint: You have looked up several usernames today. You can still continue with this username.

failed.title: Instagram is hard to read right now
failed.hint: We can't read the profile right now. You can still continue with this username and type your brand's name yourself.

brand.title: Tell us about your brand
brand.hint: A name and a sentence or two is enough. Mimo uses it to write your first post.

goal.title: What is your main goal on social media?
goal.hint: Mimo fits its content ideas to this goal.

website.title: Do you have a website?
website.hint: If you do, Mimo reads it too, to understand your products and services better. You can skip this.

language.title: Which language are your captions in?
language.hint: Used for captions and the text on slides.

posts.title: How many posts a week?
posts.hint: This becomes your schedule and content calendar. You can change it any time.

frequency.title: How often did your business post in the last month?
frequency.hint: There is no wrong answer: it helps us prepare the right guidance.

handler.title: Who runs your social media now?
handler.hint: So we know who will use Carousely.

skill.title: How good are you at social media?
skill.hint: The newer you are, the more guidance we show.

referral.title: Where did you hear about Carousely?
referral.hint: One last question, so we know how to reach people like you.

logo.title: Is this your brand's logo?
logo.hint: The logo goes on your posts, and its colours become your brand colours. You can change it any time on the Brand page.
logo.fromInstagram: Taken from your Instagram profile picture

done.title: Mimo is learning your brand
done.hint: You can make your first post in a moment. Free: {contents} posts and {chats} Mimo chat messages.

lines.profile: Reading your profile and tone of voice
